features: 1. Add padding around the inner traffic data container and its panels.
2. Rebuild the desktop/mobile account toolbar, dark search with restrained lower aurora, source RainbowButton for Add, and readable light filter arrows.
3. Unify customer credential controls in account creation and profile; keep exactly one padded password eye inside the field.
4. Add physical/logical dropdown arrow insets for LTR and RTL, in both modes.
5. More distinct primary button colors with readable automatic contrast; owner-editable palettes.
6. Make profile Usage and access independently collapsible.
7. Add a restrained green glow to active badges.
8. Full-width credential fields; real generator/clipboard pending and confirmed check states; no false clipboard success.
9. Full-width private customer page Preview action.
10. Standardized compact notification count with a gentle blink; RTL positioning and reduced-motion fallback.

11. Dedicated active/disabled account switch with no injected Save icon. Reuse canonical edit form and its activation checks, permissions and node synchronization; verify server state before updating UI.
12. Bundle the official GradFlow Stripe shader locally, use supplied light/dark triples, keep three-tone brightness relationships for happy avatar-derived colors, and support manual palettes.
13. Mobile-only centered expanding navigation pill based on the supplied component. Only the current section reveals its label; desktop navigation remains in sidebar/account menu.
14. Source RainbowButton adaptation for renewal, with light black/dark white fill, moving rainbow border and lower glow.
15. Compact Use wallet balance row with balance and Pay action below card-to-card; existing ledger, idempotency and validation preserved.
16. Match coupon Check button height to its input.

17. Owner-only Theme studio for admin/customer workspaces and independent dark/light settings: background colors/intensity, glass blur/opacity/shade/tint/neutral mode/saturation, icon/title/primary colors, presets, live preview, cancel, reset and persistent save.
18. Small gift-box shake and confetti animation on plan gifts; disabled under reduced motion.

validation.source: Python/Jinja/CSS/Bash and installer checks; 53 local JS programs/modules parse; rebuilt 47 AJAX script pins.
validation.rendered_pages: Admin/customer and Theme studio EN/FA server renders with structural assertions.
validation.css: Authored cascade verified at 390/1200px in both themes: traffic padding, desktop/mobile toolbar, RTL arrow inset, mobile-only centered dock, rainbow renewal/Add and wallet/coupon rows.
validation.shader: Glass Fold and GradFlow Stripe compile and link in native EGL OpenGL ES.
validation.theme: Owner/CSRF enforcement, invalid color/range rejection, no mutation on rejected save, durable settings visible to customer pages, both theme modes and workspaces.
validation.payments: Existing wallet renewal/idempotency/insufficient balance/commit-failure behavior tests pass.

limitations: Actual browser/iPhone visual rendering and VPS upgrade remain unverified. Native GLSL compilation and DOM/CSS checks do not replace those checks.
